literal_rule: Crypto market-structure legislation becomes U.S. federal law by Dec31 2026 11:59 PM ET. Qualifying legislation must (1) establish a comprehensive digital-asset framework beyond stablecoins alone, (2) delineate federal-agency oversight, and (3) define/classify digital assets as securities, commodities, or other categories. Examples include H.R.3633/CLARITY and FIT21. Stablecoin-only, activity-specific bans, CBDC-only, tax-only, appropriations, executive orders, agency rules/guidance do not qualify. Passage in both chambers plus presidential signature or another formal enactment mechanism is required; a Senate vote or committee action alone is not enactment.
